### 🟢 Approval recommended No active review issues are reported for the Vertex AI finish-reason mapping update. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR Aligns the Vertex AI connector with the Google AI connector by mapping additional content-related finish reasons to `CONTENT_FILTER`. **Changes:** - Maps `SAFETY`, `RECITATION`, `BLOCKLIST`, `PROHIBITED_CONTENT`, and `SPII` through a shared immutable set. - Preserves existing handling of `STOP`, `MAX_TOKENS`, and unrelated reasons. - Adds parametrized tests covering all five content-filter reasons. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `python/​tests/​unit/​connectors/​ai/​google/​vertex_ai/​services/​test_vertex_ai_utils.py` | Adds coverage for all five content-filter finish reasons. | | `python/​semantic_kernel/​connectors/​ai/​google/​vertex_ai/​services/​utils.py` | Expands the Vertex AI content-filter mapping using a shared set. |
Review effort: Balanced
